item.title: Dead pigeons in old Nisa Local, 25th August
item.description:
Pigeons have been living in this unit just above the shutter for a long time now, but the problem has recently gotten worse. The shop is covered in feathers and bird excrement, and now there are two dead pigeons dangling out of the gap in the front of the shop above the shutter. It smells very bad, attracts flies, and I think it's quite unhygenic, especially when people often walk under it.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 121, Maple Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
